KT.Name: Name
KT.WeaponAbilitiesHint: Short rule shown on the card
KT.StrengthHint: Strength accepts a number, User, +1 or x2.
KT.HitModifierHint: Cumulative penalty from flesh wounds and a broken kill team.
KT.NoWeapons: No weapons yet — use the + above.
KT.DropOperatives: Drag operatives here to add them to the roster.
KT.Dialog.AutoModifiers: Flesh wounds and broken status already apply {value} to hit.
KT.Dialog.NerveHint: +1 per friendly model shaken or out of action, -1 per friendly model within 2".
KT.Warning.NoActor: No operative selected for that roll.
KT.Warning.OperativesOnly: Only operatives can be added to a kill team roster.
KT.Dialog.InvulnerableHint: The target's invulnerable save. Leave at 0 if it has none — an invulnerable save is never modified by Armour Penetration.
KT.ModelTypeHint: The datasheet this operative was built from, e.g. Skitarii Ranger. Used for the Max limit when validating a Battle-forged kill team.
KT.CPBonusHint: Includes a bonus for each full 10 points this kill team's Force sits below the highest Force in the battle.
KT.Validate.AllClear: This kill team meets the Battle-forged restrictions.
KT.Validate.TooFewModels: A Battle-forged kill team needs at least three models ({count} selected).
KT.Validate.TooManyModels: A Battle-forged kill team may not exceed twenty models ({count} selected).
KT.Validate.NoLeader: A Battle-forged kill team must include a Leader.
KT.Validate.TooManyLeaders: A Battle-forged kill team may include only one Leader ({count} selected).
KT.Validate.TooManySpecialists: Up to three specialists are allowed besides the Leader ({count} selected).
KT.Validate.MixedFactions: All models must share a Faction keyword (found: {factions}).
KT.Validate.NoFaction: No Faction keyword is set on the selected operatives.
KT.Validate.OverForce: Force is {force} points, over the {limit} point limit.
KT.Validate.OverMax: {count} × {name} exceeds the maximum of {max} for that datasheet.
KT.Validate.OverRoster: The command roster holds {count} models, over the limit of {limit}.
KT.Chat.CommandPoints: Generates {gain} Command Point. Pool is now {total}.
KT.Chat.CommandPointsFirstRound: Generates {gain} Command Points, including {bonus} for the Force difference. Pool is now {total}.
KT.Warn.NotEnoughCP: Not enough Command Points: {cost} needed, {value} available.
KT.FactionKeywordHint: The Faction keyword as printed on a datasheet. Every model in a kill team must share one (pg 62).
KT.ParentKeywordHint: A broader Faction keyword these models also carry, e.g. Deathwatch models are also Adeptus Astartes. Leave blank if the faction stands alone.
KT.FactionApplyHint: Drag this faction onto an operative or a kill team to set its Faction keyword. Dropping it on an operative also merges the keywords above.
KT.ProfileNote.One: Choose one of the profiles below.
KT.ProfileNote.OneOrBoth: Choose one or both of the profiles below.
KT.Dialog.BothProfiles: Both profiles (-1 to all hit rolls)
KT.LevelOverrideHint: Level is set by hand, ignoring the experience track.
KT.LevelFromExperienceHint: Level is derived from the experience track.
KT.NoAbilitiesYet: No specialist abilities recorded. A specialist starts with the Level 1 ability from its tree.
KT.SpecialismUnpopulated: This specialism has no abilities recorded yet. Add them below, or from the core book.
KT.Validate.DuplicateSpecialism: Each specialism must be unique in a kill team ({count} × {specialism}).
KT.Validate.AdvancedSpecialists: {count} specialist(s) above Level 1: {names}. Normal matched play allows Level 1 only.
KT.Warn.LevelTooLow: This operative has not reached Level {level} yet.
KT.Warn.NoSpecialismDefinition: No definition found for that specialism. Import the Specialisms compendium, or create a Specialism item for it.
KT.Warn.NoAbilitiesAvailable: No abilities are available at that level. The Level 3 choices depend on which Level 2 ability was taken.
KT.Dialog.ApplyModel: Overwrite {actor}'s characteristics, points, faction and keywords with the {model} datasheet? Wargear, specialism and experience are left alone.
KT.MaxNumberHint: Maximum number of this model allowed in a kill team. '-' means unlimited.
KT.ModelDropHint: Drag this datasheet onto an operative to set its characteristics, points, faction and keywords.
KT.InvulnerableHint: Invulnerable save. Never modified by Armour Penetration. Leave blank if the model has none.
KT.Condition.NoFactionInCommon: against models with no Faction keyword in common
KT.Settings.AutoMeasureHint: Work out long range and whether a target is obscured from the tokens on the canvas, and pre-tick the attack dialog. Turn off to set them by hand.
KT.Settings.GridSizeHint: New scenes are created at this many pixels per grid square, with one square measuring one inch.
KT.Measured.OutOfRange: Out of range: {distance}" away, weapon reaches {range}".
KT.Measured.NoLineOfSight: No line of sight to the target.
KT.InnateWeapon: Every model can fight with this (pg 34)
KT.Roll.Unresolved: {count} further attack(s) not resolved: the model was already reduced to 0 wounds.
KT.Warning.NoPermission: You do not have permission to update {name}. Ask the GM to apply it.
KT.Morale.Hint: Checks whether the kill team is broken, removes Shaken tokens, then takes Nerve tests for every model with a flesh wound, and for every model if the team is broken.
KT.Morale.NoModels: This kill team has no models on the battlefield.
KT.Morale.BrokenAutomatic: Every model is wounded, shaken or out of action: the kill team is broken.
KT.Morale.BrokenTest: More than half the kill team is compromised. Rolled {total} against the highest Leadership of {target}:
KT.Morale.AlreadyBroken: The kill team is already broken and stays broken.
KT.Morale.NoBrokenTest: Half or fewer of the kill team is compromised: no test needed.
KT.Morale.NoTests: No model needs a Nerve test.
KT.Morale.Unmeasured: Some models have no token on the canvas, so the -1 for nearby friendly models could not be measured for them.
KT.Round.OrderApplies: This order applies to every phase in the battle round.
KT.Round.StatusesCleared: Readied, Advanced, Charged, Fell Back and Retreated cleared. Shaken is removed in the Morale phase.
KT.Round.RollOffAgain: Initiative cleared: roll off again for this battle round.
